verdict.rationale: Rive ships open-source runtime libraries, an MCP integration and a CLI, so a versioned-API and deprecation-policy question is fair for this product. The evidence pack documents no API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. Revision History covers design-file versions, not API versions, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
